definitions.explanation: Not precise or detailed; giving a general idea.
Not paying attention to details; lacking meticulousness.

notes:
{大雑把|おおざっぱ} is a na-adjective with two senses: "approximate" (neutral) and "sloppy/careless" (negative). Context determines which meaning applies.

FORMS:
- {大雑把|おおざっぱ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun (modifier)
- {大雑把|おおざっぱ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial: "roughly")
- {大雑把|おおざっぱ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (predicative)

ETYMOLOGY:
{大|おお} (big) + {雑把|ざっぱ} (rough grasp).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大雑把|おおざっぱ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧: rough calculation
- {大雑把|おおざっぱ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{見積|みつ}もり→見積もり：05153_mitsumori⟧: rough estimate
- {大雑把|おおざっぱ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: careless personality
- {大雑把|おおざっぱ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧: roughly speaking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{几帳面|きちょうめん}→几帳面：06868_kichoumen⟧: meticulous, precise (opposite personality trait)
- ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧: detailed, particular
- ⟦{適当|てきとう}→適当：01674_tekitou⟧: also means "rough/sloppy" but can be positive ("suitable")
